scenes.purpose: A festive tabletop that makes a folded greeting card look premium and giftable.
scenes.brief: A warm walnut tabletop with a soft linen runner, a few evergreen clippings, dried orange slices and muted brass candleholders. Gentle golden window light and a softly shadowed, nostalgic festive mood in forest green, cranberry and cream.
scenes.prompt:
Background photograph for an Etsy product listing image. A warm walnut tabletop with a soft linen runner, a few evergreen clippings, dried orange slices and muted brass candleholders. Gentle golden window light and a softly shadowed, nostalgic festive mood in forest green, cranberry and cream.
Mood: Cosy, nostalgic, tender and quietly magical, with a refined handmade feel suited to seasonal gifting.
Composition: keep the centre and lower two-thirds calm and uncluttered, because a real product will be placed on top later; keep the top quarter light and plain.
Soft natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic, premium and warm.
Do NOT include: any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; any greeting card, paper, envelope, book, screen, frame, poster, artwork or illustration; people or hands, and no European robin or any other animal.

scenes.purpose: A calm home desk or table where someone prints and folds cards.
scenes.brief: A calm pale-wood home desk with a knitted cream textile, a ceramic mug, small evergreen sprigs, simple wooden-handled scissors and a softly glowing lamp. Diffused morning light, uncluttered styling and a peaceful handmade seasonal feel.
